Dallas Detox Center Offers Addiction Treatment near University Park, TX

blocks.html:
If you have been struggling with drugs or alcohol, you may benefit from an addiction treatment program. The support that you need will depend on a few details, including the severity of your use and any risks associated with detoxification from the substances you have been abusing.

Dallas Detox is a drug and alcohol detox center near University Park, TX. Our treatment center offers detoxification and inpatient rehab programming. Detoxification is often necessary for individuals who are physically dependent on substances and those who experience adverse withdrawal effects. Our medical staff will provide you with support around the clock while monitoring known complications of detoxification. The inpatient rehab program offered at Dallas Detox can range from 30 to 90 days of treatment. The duration of your treatment plan will be dependent on the severity of your substance use disorder, any medical concerns you have, and additional mental health concerns you have. Our programs use a holistic treatment approach which means that we will support you in all the areas of your life that your use of drugs and alcohol has impacted.

We use a combination of traditional treatment options, including group therapy, individual therapy, and educational sessions in our rehab program. We offer dual-diagnosis care for individuals who are living with other mental health concerns, including anxiety, depression, bipolar disorder, borderline personality disorder, and trauma-related concerns. A unique aspect of the services offered at Dallas Detox is our Alumni services. This includes check-in visits or calls during your recovery and assistance with readmission if you find yourself in need of inpatient care down the road.
We recognize that asking for help for substance use and other mental health concerns can be difficult. Our staff strives to provide you with the support and encouragement you need in your early recovery to get your feet planted in your recovery. Before you complete your time at Dallas Detox, we will work with you to help you feel confident and prepared for your recovery at home. To take the next step in your recovery journey, we invite you to speak with a Dallas Detox representative by calling (817)904-2197.
